pattern: Takes a percentage decrease off the new price instead of the original, so a 25% cut and a 25% rise appear to cancel.
correction: A percentage always refers to the amount it is taken from. Increasing 100 by 25% gives 125; decreasing 125 by 25% gives 93.75, not 100.

pattern: Divides by the new amount when finding percentage change.
correction: Percentage change is the change as a share of the ORIGINAL amount.
